mutant.prevText: export function meOrDown(o: { service: 'ok' | 'degraded' | 'down' | 'unreachable'; internet: boolean; incident?: string }): { who: 'you' | 'us' | 'nobody'; say: string } {
mutant.nextText: if (o.service === 'down' || o.service === 'degraded') return { who: 'us', say: `It is us, not you${o.incident ? `: ${o.incident}` : ''}. We are working on it; you do not need to do anything.` };
